parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 (val_bpb 1.102 -> 1.015). The 5-minute budget seems to accommodate a larger model. Moving to explore higher learning rates and weight decay with this deeper architecture next.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 (from previous best) and testing a higher MATRIX_LR (0.1) with non-zero WEIGHT_DECAY (0.01) to see if the larger model can be stabilized and regularized more effectively.
